name: Eijin-sou
source:
On a remote island in the distant sea, there towers a shadowy mansion.

Detective Mitsugi Youichi is invited by an alluring widow and her charming twins. He follows the invitation, but what awaits him is a horrifying nightmare where the borders of real and surreal become mixed.

A memory of blood.

The warmth of meat... Then, an earsplitting screech.

In the orange glow of the setting sun, a young girl quietly whispers...

"W e l c o m e  h o m e."

[Translated from the [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/eijinsou/story.htm]Official website[/url]]
